title: 悉尼开发商资金断裂，澳洲1440亿私人信贷市场承压
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This complex of 72 apartments in Sydney's West is just one of dozens that Australian property developer Bathler Group has under construction, all of which are now in doubt.
segments.zh: 悉尼西区这个72套公寓的综合体，只是澳大利亚房地产开发商Bathler集团在建的众多项目之一，如今这些项目都面临不确定性。

segments.en: Bathler has borrowed about $2.3 billion from more than 40 Australian private credit funds, but is now run out of money. The problem goes beyond unfinished homes and unpaid staff and contractors,
segments.zh: Bathler已从40多家澳大利亚私人信贷基金借款约23亿美元，但如今资金耗尽。问题不仅限于未完工的住宅和未付薪水的员工及承包商，

segments.en: whose exposed cracks in Australia's private credit markets, Australian private credit is worth about $144 billion, and it's highly concentrated and estimated 60% of that is exposed to real estate.
segments.zh: 这暴露了澳大利亚私人信贷市场的裂缝。该市场规模约1440亿美元，且高度集中，估计其中60%涉及房地产。

segments.en: Regulator Asick issued a warning in June that private credit was facing its first real test.
segments.zh: 监管机构Asick在6月发出警告，称私人信贷正面临其首次真正的考验。

segments.en: Three back-to-back rate increases from the Reserve Bank sawing construction costs and falling property prices that left private credit exposed. And in that sense, the problem goes beyond
segments.zh: 澳大利亚储备银行连续三次加息，推高建筑成本并压较低居住成本，使私人信贷面临压力。从这个意义上说，问题不仅限于Bathler。

segments.en: just Bathler. In the words of JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon, if you see one cockroach, there's probably more.
segments.zh: 用摩根大通CEO杰米·戴蒙的话说，如果你看到一只蟑螂，可能还有更多。
